_comment: Canonical model registry — a CLOSED vocabulary. Resolution order is exact id, then exact alias, then normalised (lowercase, strip spaces/dashes/parentheses/reasoning-effort suffix), then UNRESOLVED. An unresolved name is parked in state/unresolved_models.jsonl and reported weekly; it is never auto-registered and never written into the benchmarks collection. Seeded from Epoch AI's CC-BY model catalogue by scripts/seed_models_registry.py, which is run by hand and never by the pipeline. Hand edits to an existing entry survive a re-seed; only aliases are merged in.
